title: Unique axiomatisation of fractional integral operators on the real line
summary: The Cartwright--McMullen theorem (1978) establishes the uniqueness of the Riemann--Liouville family of fractional integral operators on a compact interval $[0,1]$ under a natural set of axioms: inclusion of the classical integral, a semigroup property, positivity, and continuity. By unpacking the proof into its constituent steps and understanding its structure clearly, we provide improvements and extensions of the original result.
